title: Governor Inaugurates FENAPO 2026, Mexico's Largest Fair
description: Governor Ricardo Gallardo opened the event, while security measures and AI vehicle tracking are implemented according to reports.

sources.title: ​El gobernador Ricardo Gallardo inaugura la Fenapo 2026, la feria más grande de México
Seguridad capitalina implementa operativo vial para accesos y salidas de la FENAPO
FENAPO 2026 usará inteligencia artificial para rastrear vehículos

sections.heading: Event Inauguration
paragraphs: According to Yahoo, Governor Ricardo Gallardo inaugurated FENAPO 2026. The news source describes the fair as the largest in Mexico.

sections.heading: Traffic and Security Operations
paragraphs: Código San Luis reports that capital security has implemented a traffic operation. This measure is intended to manage access and exits for the event.

sections.heading: Artificial Intelligence Usage
paragraphs: According to Milenio, FENAPO 2026 will utilize artificial intelligence. The technology is intended to track vehicles.
